text:
ops-bot: ALERT: KV_CACHE_EVICT_HIGH firing in prod-east (sev: P1) — ~1.2k evictions over 5m, eviction_rate spike. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/kvcache/prod-east :rotating_light:

sam (oncall): ack. I'm on it. Is this causing user-facing errors?

maya (runtime): seeing a simultaneous drop in kv_hit_rate and latency regressions for small seq requests. correlates with 12:04 UTC deploy (config change to max_kv_entries).

sam (oncall): noted. grabbing logs and graphs. @deploy-bot what rolled?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T12:04:11Z by @maya — config: kv.max_entries=50k -> 20k (PR #3421) — linked at https://git.redwood/pr/3421

maya (runtime): ugh okay I remember lowering it to free memory for a test. rolling back now.

sam (oncall): executing mitigation: 1) revert config 2) temporary scale up kv-cache replicas 3) squelch pager for 10m while we stabilize. I'll post commands.

sam (oncall): runbook step:
```
# revert config
kubectl -n inference set env configmap/runtime KV_MAX_ENTRIES=50000
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-kv
```

sam (oncall): also bumping HPA target for kv-cache to 3 -> 6 to absorb pressure.

zhen (sre): +1 on revert. Also a follow-up: our alert is too noisy on short spikes. Propose change: only page when evictions_rate_pct > 0.05 for > 10m AND evictions_total > 200 in 5m.

ryan (monitoring): capturing the query we used here for the new alert:
```
(evictions_rate_by_instance > 0) and on(instance) (increase(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) > 200)
# simplified; we will convert to actual DS syntax for pager
```

leah (customer-ops): FYI support — seeing increased latencies for embeddings customers (avg request time +420ms) and a couple of timeouts. I've opened ticket SUP-879 for affected tenants. No data integrity issues reported.

sam (oncall): rollback confirmed at 12:18 UTC, pod restarts in progress. initial metrics look better — hit rate recovering. keeping monitoring on for 30m.

ops-bot: NOTE: Pager squelched for 10m by sam.

maya (runtime): root cause: an unreviewed config change in #3421 that reduced capacity for kv partitions. It was safe for dev but not at prod scale. adding a preflight check.

zhen (sre): will update the alert definition and add a suppression rule for deploy windows. Also adding a short cooldown to avoid 1-off spikes paging oncall.

ryan (monitoring): created dashboard "kv-cache-hitrate-prod-east" and a companion panel showing per-prefix growth. Query snippets attached in dashboard notes. Link: https://dash.redwood/d/kv-hit-prod-east

ryan (monitoring): new alert created: KV_CACHE_EVICT_NOISE_SQUELCH with conditions:
- evictions_rate_pct > 0.05 for 10m
- evictions_total > 200 in 5m
- AND not in deploy_window(tag:release)
Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/kvcache-eviction

sam (oncall): handing off monitoring to zhen at 12:45 UTC for post-incident follow-up. If anything flares after handoff ping me.

zhen (sre): ack handoff. I'll run through follow-ups:
- add preflight gate to config CI to detect kv.max_entries < baseline
- update alert thresholds and add squelch window during deploys
- create short-term dashboard for customer impact slices (top tenants by latency)
- postmortem doc + timeline

leah (customer-ops): support notes: SUP-879 updated with 3 impacted tenants and mitigation steps. We'll send a proactive note once postmortem is ready.

maya (runtime): follow-up PR #3430 to reintroduce safe defaults + CI check.

sam (oncall): summarizing customer impact: small spike in latency for embeddings and text-gen requests in prod-east from 12:04-12:18 UTC; timeout rate up ~0.6% (baseline 0.1%). No data loss, no broader outage.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: RESOLVED — KV_CACHE_EVICT_HIGH — acknowledged by sam — severity downgraded to P2.

ryan (monitoring): post-incident actions (created tasks):
- MON-1212: implement new alert (KV_CACHE_EVICT_NOISE_SQUELCH) and test in staging
- MON-1213: dashboard panel for per-customer eviction impact + exportable CSV
- RTE-454: CI gate for kv.max_entries minimum
- DOCS-98: update runbook with new queries and thresholds

zhen (sre): scheduling 1hr follow-up sync tomorrow to validate thresholds and run simulated eviction load test.

maya (runtime): thanks all. big lesson: conservative defaults > micro-optimizations without traffic canary.

leah (customer-ops): closing loop: once postmortem ready we'll prepare customer comms. :white_check_mark:

sam (oncall): leaving note in handoff channel and updating oncall log: https://oncall.redwood/notes/1935002468

ops-bot: Reminder: if you touched any config, add a changelog entry under infra/kvcache for audit.

zhen (sre): will take ownership of the postmortem writeup. tagging @ryan @maya for metric artifacts and @leah for customer impact text.

---
(End of thread)
